text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Israeli newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
HAARETZ
- Palestinian Authority ordered murder of 16 land dealers.
- Egypt trying to arrange meeting next week between Israeli, Palestinian negotiating teams.
- Top Israeli officers differ over ongoing deployment of troops in Lebanon.
- Wave of illegal construction in East Jerusalem. More than 1,000 violations in six months.
JEURSALEM POST
- Mixed signals on al-Baz mission.
- Police foil land dealer abduction.
- Budget posts surplus for third consecutive month.
- Strauss completes takeover of Elite.
YEDIOTH AHRONOTH
- Police: We will not hesitate to confront Palestinian security officials.
- Candidates in final election push; Labour party primaries today.
MAARIV
- Netanyahu holds urgent meeting to halt murder of Palestinian land dealers.
- Government to consider economic measures including tax on savings, foreign currency reforms and 700 million shekel budget cut.
- Labour party leader Shimon Peres cleaning out office at party headquarters in Tel Aviv.
GLOBES
- Treasury to propose tax on short term savings.
- Bank Leumi's first quarter profit 618 million shekels mainly due to sale of Africa-Israel.
